mechanism: Valproic acid may inhibit glucuronidation pathways and potentially increase empagliflozin exposure; concurrent use increases risk of euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (euDKA).
action: Monitor for signs of euDKA (nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, dyspnea, lethargy) and maintain adequate hydration; consider alternative antidiabetic agent if valproic acid continuation is necessary.
